description: Turns structured issues (the `issues` array returned by validate_feed_for_google / validate_feed_for_chatgpt / audit_product_page) into CSV text of suggested corrections (title, gtin, identifier_exists, product_type, availability, price, seller_name, Q&A template columns). Read-only: only returns file content; never writes to Merchant Center or OpenAI. Unknown values are left as TODO — nothing is invented.

include_qa.description: Incluir coluna question_and_answer com perguntas-modelo (default true).

issues.description: Array `issues` devolvido por uma das outras ferramentas.

target.description: Formato de saída; por omissão inferido das issues.
